title: OpenStax verbal: advantage of this form
stem_student: This writing of a quadratic is f(x) = a(x − h)^2 + k. What can you read from it that is harder to see when the same function is written as ax^2 + bx + c?
stem_teacher: Do not call a(x − h)^2 + k “standard form” in student prose without the Ontario naming note. OpenStax source stem uses “standard form” for vertex form.
answer: When written in that form, the vertex can be easily identified.
